title: Gildre Executive Workshop with Eric Ries: Lean in the Age of AI
summary: Eric joins Gildre for a virtual interactive workshop on Lean in the age of AI, the proven blueprints from Anthropic, Novo Nordisk, Costco, and Patagonia, and a new definition of profit. May 13 at 11 AM CST.
blockquote:
On May 13, we're hosting a session with Eric Ries that goes a bit deeper than the usual playbooks.

He's coming in right before releasing Incorruptible, and the conversation is built around a real tension most founders feel:
